 The Honourable Sri Justice N. Tukaramji

Order:

This petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashment of the proceedings in C.C.No.200218 of 2022 pending on the file of the XXII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medchal, Cybearabad against the petitioner/accused No.2.

entities.text: XXII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medchal, Cybearabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
[
2. Heard Ms.Altaf Fathima, learned counsel for petitioner, Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.

3. The petitioner is accused No.2 in C.C.No.200218 of 2022 facing accusation under Sections 420,
468, 471, 201 and read with 120-B of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner got a strong case even for quashment, as he is determined to see the process through, the insistence for his presence is causing severe difficulty in pursuing his avocation.
Therefore, prayed for dispensing his personal appearance in the proceedings, unless presence in person is required and such direction would redress his grievance.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that there is no specific objection for the prayer,
however pleaded for a direction for appearance of the petitioner on the material stages in the proceedings.
6.

Having regard to the submissions, subject to the petitioner's appearance through his counsel on every adjournment and the petitioner's presence as and when directed by the Court, the in-person presence of the petitioner in the proceedings of the C.C.No.200218 of 2022 on the file of the XXII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medchal, Cybearabad, is dispensed with.

entities.text: XXII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medchal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Additionally it is specified that any lapse in abiding the above conditions would render this order ineffective.
7. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
